name: io.github.WYRE-AI/nutanix-mcp
title: Nutanix Prism Central
description: Multitenant Streamable HTTP bridge over Nutanix's official v4 API MCP server (Prism Central).

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Public listen port for the bridge (POST /mcp, GET /health)

environmentVariables.name: IDLE_EVICT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Idle tenant timeout before an upstream child is evicted (ms)

environmentVariables.name: SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for a spawned child to answer the MCP handshake (ms)
